title: Wire RustIpfsStore into main.rs (replace MemIpfsStore)
description:
What: Replace new_mem() with a new_with_ipfs() constructor (or extend new_mem) that initializes RustIpfsStore.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs:
   a. Add async fn new_with_ipfs() -> Result<Self, String>:
      - Initialize RustIpfsStore::new().await -> ipfs_store
      - Rest of stores same as new_mem() but with persistent SQLite (from config path)
      - Return Ok(Self { ipfs_store: Arc::new(ipfs_store), ... })
2. In crates/reader/src/main.rs:
   a. Change ServerStores::new_mem() call to ServerStores::new_with_ipfs().await?
   b. If initialization fails, log error and exit with non-zero code
   c. Add --no-ipfs flag or config option to fall back to MemIpfsStore for testing
3. Keep new_mem() for integration tests (they must not require a real IPFS node)
Defensive: if IPFS init fails, log the error clearly ("IPFS initialization failed: {e}") and exit; do not continue with a broken store.
Acceptance: binary starts and accepts connections; cargo test (uses new_mem, not real IPFS) still passes; cargo build clean.
